subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: Should this issue remain the canonical terminal tool-error warning/fallback policy item after the placeholder fixes land, or should it be reduced to the existing placeholder and incomplete-turn canonical issues?
rationale: Current source shows the image-placeholder portion is partly fixed on main, but the remaining exec-like warning and lastToolError fallback behavior intersects active, conflicting policy around warning noise and replay-unsafe post-tool recovery.

options.title: Keep As Terminal Policy Item
options.body: Keep this issue open for the no-reply/tool-error contract and link the provider placeholder half to the open placeholder cluster.

options.title: Close After Placeholder Fixes Land
options.body: Treat the visible image-placeholder symptom as the central user problem and close this only after the active placeholder PRs merge with proof.

options.title: Fold Into Incomplete-Turn Canonical
options.body: Move the lastToolError/payloadCount=0 half to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88657 and leave exec warning behavior to a separate warning issue.

recommendation.title: Keep As Terminal Policy Item
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for the no-reply/tool-error contract and link the provider placeholder half to the open placeholder cluster.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent merged history on the terminal-classifier and incomplete-turn policy surface and is the best available routing owner among the traced contributors.
